### [`high_score_shift_rows`](../../../../src/highscore/high_score_shift.asm#L6) `$4D80`

*routine*

Moves the 23-byte table rows below the new entry down by one row. The row 4 entry drops out. Input: Y = 5-1 from $4c40. Y does not change.
